AgentSpecs.description: Settings for the Agent Specs content workspace view.

UserAgent.description: The User-Agent header sent when requesting a page as an agent. When empty, the default Crumpled.AgentSpecs/1.0 is used. Set this if your WAF or bot rules need to recognise or allow-list the request.

BaseUrl.description: The origin (for example https://www.example.com) that root-relative document URLs are resolved against. When empty, the scheme and host of the backoffice request are used, which relies on the site only accepting trusted Host headers. Set this to pin a trusted origin.

TimeoutSeconds.description: How long, in seconds, to wait for the page before giving up.

MaxBodyBytes.description: The largest response body to read, in bytes (default 8 MiB). A larger response is cut off and flagged as truncated.
